cat(’# melbairbnbexplore ## Overview melbairbnbexplore is an R package for ETC5523 Assignment 4. It explores Melbourne Airbnb listing prices for prospective hosts. Research Question: How do location and property type affect price in Melbourne? Important: In InsideAirbnb Melbourne, neighbourhood is actually Local Government Area (LGA) / Council Area (e.g., Bayside, Banyule, Stonnington), not suburb. Documented as such in data docs, vignette and app. ## Data Source: InsideAirbnb Melbourne 2026-09-16 (25,000+ listings, 90 cols). Raw file data-raw/listings.csv is gitignored. Cleaning in data-raw/melb_airbnb_raw.R creates data/melb_airbnb.rda with 5 cols: neighbourhood (LGA), room_type, price ($ cleaned to numeric, filtered >0 & <1000), number_of_reviews, review_scores_rating. ## Installation ```r # install.packages(“pak”) pak::pak(“ETC5523-2026/etc5523-assignment-4-adityasharma0404”)
